We need to produce a tool call. Use apply_template with molecule_smiles = product SMILES. Let's try using the unmapped product side but with mapping removed. We can strip brackets and numbers: replace patterns like [C:6] -> C, [CH3:1] -> C, [O:5] -> O, [N:8] -> N, etc. Let's manually convert.

Product side string:

[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17])[cH:18][c:19]3[c:20]2[O:21][C:22]2([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2)[CH2:26][CH2:27]3)[CH2:28][CH2:29]1

Now convert:

[CH3] -> C
[C] -> C
[CH3] -> C
[CH3] -> C
[O] -> O
[C](=[O]) -> C(=O)
[N]1 -> N1
[CH2] -> C
[CH2] -> C
[N] -> N
([c]2[cH][c]([N+](=O)[O-])[cH][c]3[c]2[O][C]2([CH2][CH2][CH2]2)[CH2][CH2]3) -> need to convert aromatic.

Let's convert aromatic part:

[c:12]2 -> c2
[cH:13] -> c
[c:14] -> c
([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17]) -> ([N+](=O)[O-]) which is nitro group attached to that carbon.
[cH:18] -> c
[c:19]3 -> c3
[c:20]2 -> c2 (closing ring)
[O:21] -> O
[C:22]2 -> C2
([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2) -> (C C C2) but need proper: (C C C2) where each CH2 is C. So (CCC2)
[CH2:26] -> C
[CH2:27]3 -> C3
) close
[CH2:28] -> C
[CH2:29]1 -> C1

Now assemble:

Start: C C(C)(C) O C(=O) N1 C C N( aromatic ) C C1

Specifically: C C(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN( aromatic )CC1

Aromatic: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2 O C2(CCC2)C3

But need proper SMILES: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Let's write: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Add aromatic numbering: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Thus full product SMILES:

CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3)CC1

But need correct aromatic: c2c c... Actually we need to ensure proper aromatic bonds: "c2c c(... )c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Write as "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Remove spaces: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3 -> "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Need to collapse: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Actually SMILES can't have spaces. So: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3" -> "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Let's rewrite as "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Remove spaces: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3" -> "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". This is still ambiguous.

Better to use original aromatic pattern: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Thus final SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3)CC1

But need correct aromatic: "c2c c" should be "c2c c"? Actually "c2c" then "c" then etc. Let's write as "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Combine: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Remove spaces: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Still spaces.

Let's produce a plausible SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3)CC1". Need to ensure aromatic ring closure: c2c...c3c2...c3.

Thus: "c2c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3" -> "c2c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". That seems correct: aromatic carbon with nitro, then two carbons, then fused to second ring.

So final product SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)C3)CC1

Now apply template.
